setting: You are all members of the same allotment society in one English town, and most of you have known each other through the plots for years, though Amy joined only recently. At the moment you are getting ready for winter: repairing the shared tool shed roof, chasing this year's subscriptions, and planning the January meeting.
openers: Ask who can help fix the shed roof
Propose a date for the January meeting
Share a photo of the leeks

text: Proposing Mon 11 Jan, 7.30pm, scout hut for the January meeting. Any objections? 🙂
Works unless I'm on nights. Will check the rota
11th fine for me. can we move subs to the top of the agenda tho? still 9 unpaid as of today
Subs first, yes. Will sort the agenda Friday.
Roof: Kev reckons Saturday if it stays dry. Need four people for the morning. Who?
i can do sat!! will bring my own gloves this time (after last week's splinter incident )
Sat morning I'm off, can do. Not the afternoon
cant sat, sorry. wedding in Leeds. will pay for the screws tho, send me the receipt
Thanks Tom. That's two of us plus Amy, need one more.
I can help with the roof on Saturday morning. I'll bring a flask. The eleventh is fine for me, though if anyone is on nights the eighteenth might suit better.
18th better for me. 11th I'm on nights. Sorry Alan
18th then. 7.30, scout hut. I'll tell Kev. 🙂
18th works!! can I bring the lemon drizzle this time i'll make it sat night after roof dont let me near the biscuits
The eighteenth suits me. Alan, I will bring the urn for the meeting if nobody else has.
Brilliant. Thank you Sheila, the urn would be great.
